type Boxes<T> = { [K in keyof T]: { value: T[K] } };
type ReadonlyBoxes<T> = { readonly [K in keyof T]: { value: T[K] } };
type WritableBoxes<T> = { -readonly [K in keyof T]: { value: T[K] } };
function unbox(input: any): any {
  const output: any = {};
  for (const key in input) output[key] = input[key].value;
  return output;
}
function plain<T>(input: Boxes<T>): T { return unbox(input); }
function readonlyMap<T>(input: ReadonlyBoxes<T>): T { return unbox(input); }
function writableMap<T>(input: WritableBoxes<T>): T { return unbox(input); }
const source: { value?: { value: string } } = { value: { value: 'hello' } };
const readonlySource: { readonly value?: { value: string } } = source;
const result = plain(source);
const fromReadonly = plain(readonlySource);
const readonlyMapped = readonlyMap(readonlySource);
const writable = writableMap(source);
const missing: typeof result = {};
const indexed: typeof result['value'] = result['value'];
const { value } = result;
readonlyMapped.value = 'updated';
console.log(value.toUpperCase(), indexed.toUpperCase(), fromReadonly.value.toUpperCase(), readonlyMapped.value.toUpperCase(), writable.value.toUpperCase(), Object.keys(missing).length);
